rules.closePositionWhenHeadcountFilled: When a hire brings the number of hired applications of a job position up to its headcount, the position moves from open to closed automatically and its closing time is recorded.
rules.positionClosesWhenHeadcountFilled: A job position is filled, and must be closed, once the number of its applications in the hired stage is equal to or greater than its headcount; a position that is not filled stays open.
rules.recruiterMovesScreeningAndInterview: Only a recruiter records applications, moves an application from screening to interview, and rejects applications with a reason; the offer and hired stages are not set by the recruiter.
rules.onlyPositionHiringManagerDecides: Only the hiring manager assigned to the application's job position may move an application from interview to offer or from offer to hired.
rules.hireWithinRemainingHeadcount: An application can be moved to hired only while its job position is open and still has at least one remaining opening.
rules.rejectionRequiresReason: An application can be rejected only from screening, interview or offer, and only when a non-empty rejection reason is given; the rejection time and the stage at rejection are recorded with it.
rules.applicationOnlyToOpenPosition: A new application can be recorded only for a job position whose status is open.
rules.headcountAtLeastOne: The headcount of a job position must be a whole number of at least one.
rules.hiringManagerSeesOwnPositions: A hiring manager sees only the job positions where they are the assigned hiring manager and only the applications to those positions.
rules.applicationNumberFromSequence: Each application receives its application number from the platform number sequence when it is recorded, and that number never changes.
rules.applicationStartsInScreening: Every newly recorded application starts in the screening stage.
rules.oneActiveApplicationPerCandidateAndPosit: A candidate may have at most one active application, in screening, interview or offer, for the same job position at a time.
rules.candidateRequiresEmail: A candidate can be registered only with an e-mail address, which is linked to the candidate as an e-mail contact channel.
rules.candidateSourceRequired: A candidate can be registered only when the recruiter records the source channel through which the candidate reached the organization.
rules.inactiveHiringManagerCannotBeAssigned: Only an active hiring manager can be assigned as the hiring manager of a new job position.
rules.remainingOpeningsCalculated: The hires so far of a job position are the count of its applications in the hired stage, and its remaining openings are the headcount minus the hires so far, never below zero.
rules.applicationActiveWhileInPipeline: An application is active while its stage is screening, interview or offer, and is no longer active once it is hired or rejected.
rules.daysInPipelineCalculated: The days in pipeline of an application are the days from its application date until today, or until the day it was hired or rejected.
